answer: Prayers & Duties >> Taharah (Purity) Question ID: 37048 Country: India Title: Is it required for a woman to take ghusl if she has wet dreams Question: I have question regarding ghusl. (1) Is it required for a woman to take ghusl if she has wet dreams? And I am ashamed to ask this 2nd question, does woman require having ghusl after orgasm due to masturbation? Please try to answer question as soon as possible. Answer ID: 37048 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 272/212/B=1433) (1) Yes, it is wajib on a woman to have ghusl if she has wet dream. (2) If semen is discharged after masturbation then ghusl is wajib. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
